summary: SciSparc Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing its subsidiary NeuroThera Labs Inc. closed a C$5.4 million private placement on August 15, 2026. SciSparc subscribed for 22,500,000 units at C$0.12 per unit, each unit comprising one common share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.16 for 36 months. NeuroThera may accelerate expiry of 50% of unexercised warrants upon Nasdaq listing. SciSparc's stake valued at approximately C$30 million, implying a significant uplift. This is a subscription by the parent into its subsidiary, not a buyback or dividend. The category is misapplied; more accurately a capital infusion, thus 'None' fits better.
